part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `ACLSelectorRemoveCommandRule` (src/server.c:3197): it removed matching rules with an in-place `memmove`, but after each removal the scanning pointer continued at a stale offset in the shifted buffer, so later rules (e.g. `+config|get`) could be left behind even though the command's bitmap was correct — causing `ACL LIST`/`ACL GETUSER` to show rules that didn't match actual permissions.

The fix rebuilds the rules string instead of shifting bytes under a live pointer. Verified:
- Issue scenario now yields `user user1 ... -@all +config` (no stale `-config|set`)
- `unit/acl`, `unit/auth`, `unit/introspection` all pass
